notes.title: We are still around and working on bringing great updates to this game
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

The team at AGS is thrilled to announce that we are back on track with the development of Endure or Perish. After a brief hiatus due to a health concern within our close-knit team, we are happy to report a full recovery and a return to our passion project. We understand the anticipation and patience our fans have shown during this period, and we're eager to reward that loyalty with a host of new features. The upcoming updates promise to enhance your gaming experience with the introduction of a dynamic vehicle system and an expansive new map to explore. Stay tuned for more details, and thank you for your continued support!

AGS

notes.title: Development Update 8
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=U0gslEZiMdw;full][/previewyoutube]
Get ready for the most epic Endure or Perish adventure ever! Are you excited for the ground-shaking, hair-raising Endure or Perish Update 8? Prepare yourselves for the thrilling, heart-pounding news that will skyrocket your gaming journey to unprecedented heights! Dive into the mind-blowing details of the Endure or Perish latest development news, featuring game-changing elements that will revolutionize your gameplay experience. From the dynamic weather system that will immerse you in the raindrops and sunshine like never before to the revamped day-night cycle that injects a new level of realism, every moment will be filled with exhilaration. And the precise timekeeping? It will have you on the edge of your seat, ensuring every second counts in this adrenaline-pumping Endure or Perish Update 8 adventure!
[Weather System]
First things first a brand new system introduced to the game, weather. Weather will include all of the below.
[list]
[*]Clear Skies
[*]Cloudy Skies
[*]Overcast Skies
[*]Rain
[*]Light Rain
[*]Thunderstorm
[/list]

These systems are set to change every in-game hour to more fully round out the gaming experience. While not a factor yet, a future update will make planning for weather and ensuring buildings are complete important. 

[Day Night System]
We are delighted to announce the remarkable improvements we have implemented in our Day-Night System! In our latest update, not only will you find a meticulously designed moon illuminating the night sky, but we have also integrated captivating Dynamic Lighting in the gaming Map. These enhancements are aimed at providing players with truly immersive gaming experiences by elevating the visuals through enhanced gaming visuals and mesmerizing gaming lighting effects. Experience the enhanced Day-Night cycle gaming like never before and plunge into the world of unparalleled immersive gaming.

In our latest update, we have fine-tuned the timing of sunset and sunrise for a more natural feel. Say goodbye to the old 30-second-before-and-after-midnight routine! Now, with the sunset and sunrise placed at more realistic intervals, players can enjoy a more authentic transition from day to night.

Speaking of night time, get ready to bask in the shadows for a longer duration! Night time will now extend to a thrilling 15 real-world minutes, a substantial upgrade from the previous 3 to 5 minute stint. Dive into the darkness and immerse yourself in the atmosphere like never before! Let the adventure begin under the captivating night sky!
I'm thrilled to share that a new system will be implemented in the next few weeks, allowing players to sleep through the night! This means you can easily bypass the challenges of navigating in the dark during thunderstorms or overcast conditions. Say goodbye to bunkering down or relying solely on torches for nighttime exploration. Get ready for a more convenient and enjoyable gaming experience with this upcoming update!

[Forests]
We are thrilled to announce that we've implemented major enhancements to the game's forest environment! In earlier versions, the forests appeared sparse with only a few trees. But now, we've completely revamped the forests to give them a more natural and abundant look. You can expect to see around 15 different tree varieties, including 5 dead trees, various types of stumps, 4 distinctive bushes (not yet harvestable), and 4 different types of logs scattered across the forest floor. Everything in this landscape, except the bushes, can be harvested for valuable materials. Get ready to explore and experience the lush and diverse forest like never before!

[Time Keeping]
One of the major changes you'll notice is the awesome new hour and minutes time system replacing the old sunrise, midday, sunset, midnight system. Get ready for a more accurate way to track time in your adventures! How cool is that? Time to dive in and enjoy the updated game experience!

notes.title: Development Update 7

Below players will get a detailed breakdown of what is new in this current update and what has been improved upon!

[Build system]

[list]
[*]We added a few new buildable objects
[list]
[*]A greenhouse wall
[*]A greenhouse door wall
[*]A greenhouse roof
[*]A greenhouse corner roof
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/83f5fec554c98a68e4d5194159a66ec6383b0a31.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch #5
notes.notes:
Greetings to all gamers and enthusiasts,

In response to feedback from the gaming community, we are introducing this patch to address several reported issues.

One of the key problems we resolved pertained to difficulties experienced when attempting to fit a door into its frame, which resulted in incorrect placement and hindered movement through the structure. Through adjustments made to the mechanics, we have successfully restored the proper snapping functionality, ensuring precise door alignment.

Another issue that came to our attention involved players being able to construct multiple buildings in the same spot, leading to unwanted overlapping structures. Following modifications to the building system, such occurrences will now be prevented, as only one building can occupy any given location at a time.

Furthermore, we are excited to announce an upcoming update currently in the final testing phase, scheduled for release this Saturday. This update will focus on farming, granting players the opportunity to cultivate various plants scattered across the map, such as watermelon, cantaloupe, cucumber, corn, and potato. Stay tuned for more details on this agricultural-themed content.

We value the ongoing support of our community. Should you have any suggestions or encounter bugs while playing, please feel free to reach out to us via email or by using the in-game feedback button. Your input is instrumental in enhancing the gaming experience for all.

notes.title: Development Update 5
notes.notes:
Dear gamers and enthusiasts, we are pleased to inform you that a new developmental update has been released. Although this update may be smaller in size compared to our usual releases, any update brings exciting new content to the game, making it worth the anticipation.

Below you’ll find a detailed list of additions and fixes made Endure or Perish. 

[Build System]
To start out we added beams to the game with their respective update counter parts. There are 2 sizes of beams, a full-length beam, which is the length of a wall, when erected upright, or the length of a foundation/floor when erected horizontally. These beams can have walls, roofs, floors, and other beams snapped to them during building. There is also a half length beam. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/9d6ca3d8744df63e6ea29d727ec196d8021f1fdd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/14a1291fd147c8aad3da2509ab6c4a50c43ccd90.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/47b7a59da7774bd81d9b37df6bdcca9d4f120782.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/411dd9729065cf1fd41978e5e32e3b7746240247.png[/img]
We also made it possible to move snapped builds as well. Previously only free-floating foundations could be moved up and down, we enabled this feature on all builds whether free floating or not. 
We also reset the rotation of builds so when a new item is placed the rotation will automatically return to 0. Previously newly placed builds would hold onto the previous builds’ rotation. 
We also adjusted the size of the half walls so they aren’t as short as they had been. 

That’s all we have for you this week. Keep tuned we’ll be releasing a road map for future update in the next few weeks that will outline the plan for updates for the remainder of the year. 
As always, we appreciate the support of our fans and look forward to continuing to working together. If you have any suggestions for features, found a bug, don't hesitate to contact us and let us know, either through the feedback button in the game, or emails us.

notes.title: Level Update 1
notes.notes:
Greetings, gamers. We have some exciting news for you. The latest feature update for Endure or Perish is now available after a rigorous three-week development period. We appreciate your patience and support during this time, and we are sure that you will love the result of our hard work. The update brings many improvements and new content to the game, so don't miss it.

Throughout the last few weeks of development, we have implemented various enhancements to enhance the quality of life. However, we would like to center this announcement on the key highlight of the update, which is the upgraded and brand new map. For those players who have been actively engaged in the game and are not yet prepared to embark on a new map, there is no need to feel discouraged. Your existing world will continue to function, albeit with the removal of certain features like enemy waves and aggressive animal mobs. Nevertheless, fundamental activities such as construction, crafting, inventory management, and the overall map structure will persist and remain fully accessible for gameplay.

To start this announcement properly we'll focus first on the biggest most noticeable change a brand-new map. This update boasts a brand new map. There are certain things players will notice on loading a new game. 
[olist]
[*]The new map is about twice as big as the original map providing more ground to explore and more options for base building
[*]There are more POI's (Points of Interest) to explore
[list]
[*]This was a common request for the original map, there weren't that many places to explore and what places there were to explore the POI's were quite small. 
[*] There are now 4 POI's visible on the main map
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/609efc4c8d67712222bc6fd54be6d35fa8286110.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/1f4352fcb17233124c578d1d326157dead394e93.png[/img]
[*] There are also 5 hidden aircraft crashes scattered around the map that has lootable chests scattered about the crash. Some are fairly easy to find others will be hidden
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/b86835fb0152c75166c8216f3457f314d758297b.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] The map also has new biomes
[olist]
[*]A mountain Biome which is visible on the main map in the middle of the map. This is where all the ore producing nodes will spawn
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/3e95f2ea4d016cb9669b5bc7bd7452441d9bbfed.png[/img]
[*] The map also has a large swamp biome on the bottom right of the main map as well as smaller swamps scattered around the map. This is where all the clay and sand producing notes will be spawn
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/fdf599b0376718eb6395956cd2ee1cb2c61f4cf4.png[/img]
[/olist]
[/olist]
In addition to the new map we also made other improvements and additions to the game as well. 

[AI]
We made some improvements to both the enemy/hostile animal AI tracking, as well as how peaceful animals spawn
[list]
[*]Improved Player Tracking
[list]
[*]In the old map the AI was a lot easier to elude
[*]The improved AI makes eluding the AI much more difficult adding another layer of challenge and strategy to the game especially when exploring POI's where enemy's tend to congratulate. 
[/list]
[*] Improved Peaceful Animal Spawning
[list]
[*]The Peaceful animal spawning system is now more uniform and balanced
[/list]
[/list]

[Resource Gathering]
We also made some improvements and changes to how resources spawn.
[list]
[*]We increased the distance that food plants such as cucumbers, corn, and watermelon plants spawn in relation to the player.
[list]
[*]Players will now have to plan trips to gather these resources when they begin to run low. 
[/list]
[*] we also increased the distance that sticks and stones will naturally spawn in relation to the player.
[list]
[*]Meaning that the player will need to employ some strategy while gathering these early game resources
[*] Due to the distance being increased with the stones and sticks we doubled how many sticks and stones will spawn as well.
[/list]
[/list]

[Maps and Navigation]
We also made some changes and improvement to the minimap as well as the main map
[list]
[*]Due to a new level being released we created a new main map that matches the terain and landscape of the new level. 
[*] We also introduced a new minimap. 
[list]
[*]The new minimap will no longer display enemy markers but a sharp eye on the map will reveal not just enemies approaching but will also show animals, as well as hidden items that can't be seen from the ground. 
[/list]
[*] Location marks will also now appear on the main map. 
[/list]

[Inventory]
We also fixed a few bugs that were found in the inventory during the testing phase of this update. We also added a way for players to drop items from the hot bar. Before players would need to drag the item from the hot bar into their inventory then drag and drop the item to the ground. 

[Player stats]
[list]
[*]We added fall damage to the player
[*] players will now need to be cautious when jumping off of items and places to avoid injury. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/cbed01dfb819a1066362dac0bc15d552352410de.gif[/img]
[/list]

[Build System]
We also added a couple of new items to the game that players can build to enhance game play. 
[list]
[*]Added a dead fall trap to provide an alternate source of meat. 
(NOTE: While the trap is free to reset, a future update will see a cost associated with resetting the trap)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/eb5db56014596669045d81404c933b378e4ae8a4.png[/img]
[*] We also added a new half wall to the game with its associated upgrades
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/3a1c76c7101b5826445149eab61050ede2a2db66.png[/img]
[*] We also added a new roof corner piece to provide more options for roof layout and pattern
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/63b1617166eea8417c62eb367228fb38522eee9d.png[/img]
[/list]

[Crafting System]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in the sawmill that prevented the mill from working once its inventory had either filled up or been emptied. 
[*] Also increased the size of the sawmill inventory
[/list]

[Tutorial System]
This update includes a new in game tutorial along with an option in the tutorial menu of the pause menu to disable the tutorial. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/d468cf1d9651ddf9628c3e81ae983847fb676b33.png[/img]

[Player Controls]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in which items that can be consumed such as food, when the entire stack is moved, one item is consumed during the movement of the stack. 
[*] Changed the use item key from [CTRL] to [Shift]
[*] Updated the instructions in the player inventory
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/26871dc9e8c2915bf2bcd13ed4c9f79994dd9e68.png[/img]
[/list]

[UI]
[list]
[*] Improved the UI that gives players info on builds such as walls, foundations, ect
[*] Before the builds are complete the UI will display the resources and hammer required to complete the build and quantity required. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/05a4a8da5f781573d575c7848ee0491136307b25.png[/img]
[/list]

We again want to express our appreciation to our fans and am grateful for your support. While it did take a while to get this update out, we have many more ideas and updates that we are eager to work and push out to you guys, so expect to see many more additions to the game. 

To see this update in action purchase the game and play it now!!!

notes.title: Addressing an abusive review
notes.notes:
Attention Gamers!

Our fans should be aware that we value and endorse individual opinions and beliefs, emphasizing everyone's right to express their thoughts. Nonetheless, advocating opinions without substantiated evidence is not within our support. We strongly condemn any form of abusive conduct and strive for the gaming community to remain a secure environment where gaming enthusiasts can unite, celebrating both their disparities and commonalities. It is our conviction that in case of dissatisfaction with a studio or its products, providing a courteous and truthful review is more effective than resorting to disparaging remarks and slanderous language.

It, unfortunately, has come to our knowledge that there has been a review left that, yes has the gamers opinions, which he has a right to have and share, but it also contains very abusive and slanderous language, as well as baseless accusations. 

Our game has been accused of being a carbon copy of another developer's work by the name of Difuse Studios. the work being called [url=https://www.unrealengine.com/marketplace/en-US/product/survival-game-kit]The Survival Game Kit[/url]. We at Ascent Gaming Studios did not know such an asset pack existed until we reviewed our recent reviews. After carefully reading this user's review, we could not find any facts or evidence in the review to explain why the user believes our game is a carbon copy and thus an asset flip. Curious to see how alike our game was to the asset pack, we acquired it and looked over how it functions on the gaming level and we can say that from the outside it does appear to use many of the same systems that we use in our game, but so does a lot of other very popular games that are available on the steam platform, many of which are favorites of our crew. However, when you look at what's going on under the hood, so to speak, it begins to become quite evident that the coding and implementation could not be more different. The best way we can put it is a difference between gasoline cars and electric cars. On the outside they function practically identically, they get you from point a to point b, but under the hood the way the cars accomplish this could not be more different. 

We agree that there are developers out there that may be asset flipping, but writing a slanderous review with no evidence as to why the work is an asset flip does no one any help both in the player community, as well as in the developer community. Simply because a game appears to have the same functionality as other popular games and asset packs does not make those games Asset Flips. If it did, then some of the most popular games on Steam would be considered Asset Flips. 

We strongly believe that everyone has a right to their opinion and would never discourage a truthful and respectful review of our work, whether positive or negative. While developers prefer positive reviews, negative reviews, at least the truthful, honest, and respectful reviews, are the most helpful as they provide developers insight into how they can improve their work to meet the expectations of their audience. 

The only thing we at Ascent Gaming Studios ask is if you have questions, concerns, or comments, to reach out to us. We are willing to have a respectful and honest discussion and willing to answer any questions with transparency. And if our game, or anyone's game for that matter, just isn't to your liking we encourage you to leave a review explaining why, but we ask that you are truthful, respectful, and honest. 

As always, we appreciate our fans and their support and look forward to growing together and growing the gaming community. 

Ascent Gaming Studios

notes.title: Developmental Update #3
notes.notes:
Developmental Update #3 brings some exciting new features to the build system, enhancing the game play of Endure or Perish. You can now create more complex and diverse structures with the new additions. We've also improved some aspects of the game to make it more enjoyable and smooth. You can read more about the changes and fixes in the detailed description below. Don't miss this opportunity to experience the update and get your copy today.

[Build system] 
You can now create railings to add more safety and style to your base. Each one has its own advantages and disadvantages, so experiment and see what works best for you. Railings can be placed on any edge of a floor or ceiling tile, the stair railings snap to the side of any exterior stairs and they will automatically snap to the right angle. You can also rotate them manually if you want more control over the placement. Railings are a great way to make your base more realistic and attractive, so try them out today!
[olist]
[*]Half Railing
[*]Full length Railing
[*]Stair railings
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/c2f646aa2304e7ea69bb5126bee8e80e3b14f163.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/fe68b50380c9e83cc96561a0e3af642970e931a9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/7c51b653e501c50dfa9181b6ccf5850c0dae5160.png[/img]

We have resolved an issue with the building system ghost. Previously, players could interact with build ghosts before they finished the build, which was not intended. Now, players will pass through build ghosts and only be able to interact with them when they are completed. This also applies to defensive traps, which will not protect players until the trap is fully built.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/b65d1a18c95db4cb905d665ce9949abb6d77361f.png[/img]

Resolved an issue with build relocation. Some players reported that they could relocate built structures but not their pending ones. This issue has been fixed and pending structures can now be relocated.

[Inventory System]
We have made some enhancements to the Inventory system to optimize its performance and functionality. We have also fixed some issues that were reported by our users.

[AI system]
You can now get loot from enemy AI's when you kill them. They might drop different items, such as ores, foods, tools, or weapons. These items can help you survive and craft better equipment. But not every zombie will have a loot drop. This is intentional and not a bug. It makes the game more challenging and realistic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795469/e55ac22654fdb13be1aee1fb0b000df076b6baab.png[/img]

[QOL improvements]

We have revised and edited the tutorial's writing style and item descriptions to eliminate grammar and spelling mistakes and enhance readability.

notes.title: Emergency patch
notes.notes: Patched a bug that was causing players systems to freeze then crash while attempting to load a game, or start a new game.

notes.title: Hotfix V1.01
notes.notes:
When interacting with certain builds such as work benches or storage chests players could interact and use them before the build was complete. Now players will need to complete the building of these objects in order to interact and use with these objects. 

When swimming, players could stay underwater forever due to not having to worry about how much air they had left. Now air level will display as oxygen and drain while the player is swimming. If the player stays underwater too long you will drown.
